title: Publication
description: A news site or magazine with the transparency pages that Google News looks for: editorial standards, authors, contact and imprint. The latest articles live on a news page.

edits.text: How we report, check and correct
We publish what we can confirm from our own reporting or from at least two independent sources.
Opinion pieces are marked as opinion. Sponsored content is labelled and kept apart from reporting.
Every article shows when it was published and when it was last updated.
When we get something wrong, we correct it in the article and say what changed and when.
The people who write for us
Every article names its author in the byline, and the name links to the author's page.
Each author page shows a short biography and every article by that person, newest first.
Authors write about subjects they know from their own work or research and name the sources they draw on.
To reach an author, use the contact page and we will forward your message.
